name: Cassie Mathers
source:
After a falling out with Leslie, Cassie spent the next 18 years living in the country. When events forced her to return to Vesper City, she decided to try to repair her relationship with Leslie.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
